patch.value: Intent omission decisions miss shaped, resumed and direct-SDK reads: include projection runs after the omission decision, an outputCursor replay of an omitted intent throws read_output_cursor_stale, and a direct attachContextIntentReceipt omission carries no read_output

CodeRabbit review of PR 1681 (deferred as heavy-lift for that batch). (1) A get intent with outputInclude item.id can refuse a 600-token budget because an unselected subtree exceeds it, even when the id and receipts fit. The include projection should be measured before the omission decision. (2) Replaying an outputCursor with an intent budget that omits the result runs row continuation on the refusal, which throws read_output_cursor_stale instead of returning the refusal and its receipts. (3) An SDK consumer that calls attachContextIntentReceipt directly with an infeasible numeric outputBudget gets an output_budget_exceeded value without read_output, which isReadOutputBudgetExceeded still accepts. The attachReadOutputContracts path is fixed by PR 1681; the direct helper is not.

An intent omission is decided over the projection the caller requested; a cursor replay of an omitted intent returns the refusal with its receipts; every value isReadOutputBudgetExceeded accepts carries a measured read_output receipt, including a direct attachContextIntentReceipt call; specs with negative controls cover each case
